review: 702.110b: triaged definitional, but it decides whether a 'when this exploits a creature' trigger fires; reclassified mechanical/direct/trigger and added scenario 702.110b-1 contrasting a sacrifice to the exploit trigger with a sacrifice to Bloodthrone Vampire.

scenarios.title: Exploit lets the controller sacrifice a creature as the enters trigger resolves

setup.notes: Vulturous Aven is a 2/3 flier with exploit: when it exploits a creature, A draws two cards and loses 2 life.

decisions: A casts Vulturous Aven, tapping all four Swamps; the creature spell resolves.
The exploit trigger goes on the stack; both players pass.
As the trigger resolves, A sacrifices Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is sacrificed and goes to A's graveyard. The Aven exploits a creature: A draws two cards and loses 2 life, so A is at 18 and the Aven stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: decline
variants.delta: A declines to sacrifice a creature as the trigger resolves.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield and Vulturous Aven stays too. A draws no cards and loses no life, and stays at 20.

variants.label: sacrifice-itself
variants.delta: A sacrifices Vulturous Aven itself instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Vulturous Aven goes to A's graveyard, Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield, and the Aven's trigger still counts as exploiting a creature: A draws two cards and is at 18.

scenarios.title: A creature exploits only a creature sacrificed as its exploit ability resolves

setup.notes: Vulturous Aven: when it exploits a creature, A draws two cards and loses 2 life. Bloodthrone Vampire: sacrifice a creature: it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

decisions: A casts Vulturous Aven, tapping all four Swamps; the creature spell resolves and its exploit trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; as the exploit trigger resolves, A sacrifices Grizzly Bears if Grizzly Bears is still on the battlefield, and otherwise sacrifices nothing.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears goes to A's graveyard. Vulturous Aven's exploits-a-creature trigger fires: A draws two cards and is at 18.

variants.label: sacrificed-elsewhere
variants.delta: With the exploit trigger on the stack, A sacrifices Grizzly Bears to Bloodthrone Vampire's ability instead.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears goes to A's graveyard and Bloodthrone Vampire is 3/3 until end of turn. The exploit trigger resolves with no sacrifice and the exploits-a-creature trigger does not fire: A draws no cards and stays at 20.
